picks a dataset from
Data Sources" style="rounded=1;html=0;arcSize=10;fontColor=#1A1A19;fontSize=12;fillColor=#EAF2FF;strokeColor=#6C8EBF;" vertex="1" parent="1"> <mxGeometry x="40" y="86" width="180" height="80" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="n_split" value="Train-Test Split

Run All Experiments (toolbar,

up to 1,000 rows; model nodes
skipped; temporary files only,

sample data for each path;
